## Type of change

- [ ] 🌱 New skill (`feat: add [skill] to [category]`)
- [ ] ⬆️ Skill upgrade (`improve: [skill] — v1→v2` or `v2→v3`)
- [ ] 📊 Benchmark (`benchmark: [skill-a] vs [skill-b]`)
- [ ] 🗺️ System / Blueprint (`system: add [name]`)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (`fix: ...`)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation (`docs: ...`)
- [ ] 🔧 CI/tooling (`chore: ...`)

## Checklist

### For skill contributions
- [ ] Follows the schema in `meta/skill-template.md`
- [ ] Has a working, runnable Python code example
- [ ] Includes typed inputs and outputs
- [ ] Includes at least one failure mode
- [ ] All internal links are valid
- [ ] Frontmatter version is bumped (if upgrading)

### For all PRs
- [ ] `python tools/check_skill_quality.py` passes (if modifying skills)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials in code
- [ ] Conventional commit format used
